newsitem.title: USA: U.S. copper service center shipments rise in Aug.
newsitem.headline: U.S. copper service center shipments rise in Aug.

text.p: Service center shipments of copper and brass mill products climbed 8 percent in August from July, with the largest volume category, alloy sheet, coil and strip, leading the way with a month-to-month gain of 13.4 percent, Copper and Brass Servicecenter Association reported.
The average daily shipping rate during August was 2.8 percent ahead of the prior month.
There was an overall decrease in distributors' inventories during August, although less than a 1 percent decline in both copper and alloy products.
Compared to August 1995, service center stocks of copper products in August this year were down 13.3 percent, and alloy products off 21.5 percent.

"Although there continue to be mixed signals in the marketplace, at this point there seems to be more feeling on the optimistic rather than the pessimistic side relative to business in our industry for the final quarter of the year," the Association's report said.
